newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African revenue receipts slow in August.
newsitem.headline: South African revenue receipts slow in August.

text.p: Revenue receipts slowed in August to 10.145 billion rand from 13.922 billion rand in July, figures released by the South African Finance Department on Thursday show.
But the department said the figure was expected to improve over the next three months when provisional taxes were paid.

It said total receipts for the first five months of the 1996/97 (April/March) financial year amounted to 50.373 billion rand, representing about 34.8 percent of the total 144.9 billion rand budget -- ahead 3.7 percent on the same period last year.

Total spending jumped 44.28 percent to 18.476 billion rand from 12.805 billion rand in July, bringing total exchequer issues for the April to August period to 72.8 billion rand -- 41.9 percent of the total 173.695 billion rand budget.
